schema_version: Draft v1.8 external archive; not verified pushed canonical schema
email_source: user-supplied Pasted markdown.md (message date not supplied)

status_definitions.OK: Scoped field/event representation and cited static probes; no semantic, runtime, or full-schema sign-off.
status_definitions.CHANGE REQUIRED: Specific missing field/event/semantic invariant or disagreement with current owner contract.
status_definitions.OPEN: Concretely represented in part but exact joint interpretation or interface remains undecided.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw request, normalized fields/query, revision, application identity, synthetic-data marker
rows.assessment: Envelope retains request identity, revision, raw input, normalized container and synthetic marker. Normalization linkage is E08.

rows.minimum_evidence: Prompt/template version, actual rendered input/context reference, selected provider, configured model identifier, returned model identifier/version when available, model/configuration version, generation parameters, model response/refusal/error, latency and token/usage metadata when available
rows.assessment: Rendered input/output and token usage are present, but the model_call shape lacks a complete refusal/provider-error and per-call requested-versus-observed configuration mapping. Mohab/Alaa must map these explicitly.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw/effective query, filters/k, policy set and retriever versions
rows.assessment: Policy-search call/result and versions exist. No explicit raw-to-effective query mapping or complete applied filter/applicability snapshot is present; policy_ids is not a full filter record.

rows.minimum_evidence: Query, effective query, k, filters, corpus/index/embedding/retriever configuration
rows.assessment: Effective query, k and corpus/index/retriever/embedding lineage exist; effective tenant/ACL/applied filters are absent. Empty successful retrieval now passes POS-13. Embedding configuration and store remain separately conditional.

rows.minimum_evidence: Full ordered returned list; document/source/chunk IDs, versions, text/snapshot, hashes and locators
rows.assessment: Ordered document/chunk/version/source/hash text and selected slices are represented; no runtime retention or semantic relevance claim.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw finite score, metric kind/direction, returned rank, tie rule, returned count
rows.assessment: Rank/score and metric direction/availability exist; tie rule, finite/null score convention and RAG returned-count rule are not bound to a versioned retriever configuration.

rows.minimum_evidence: Selected IDs/order/text spans, rejected IDs/reasons, sufficiency outcome, unresolved facets/conflicts, selection version
rows.assessment: Selected text/order and exclusion reason, facets and conflicts exist; no resolved selector-version identity for the selection procedure.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw-to-normalized field links, validation details, amount/currency/request revision
rows.assessment: Root request, raw proposed arguments and normalized tool arguments are present; source-to-normalized field links and clarification record for the original request are not demonstrated.

rows.minimum_evidence: Previous/new state, reason, input/result references, transition attempted vs accepted, state revision
rows.assessment: State revision and attempted/accepted transitions are represented; NEG-35 prevents COMPLETED with unresolved recovery. Approval validity ordering is assessed separately under E14/E17.

rows.minimum_evidence: Coarse stage at proposal/check/dispatch, state-to-stage mapping version
rows.assessment: Coarse stage fields exist. Mohamed/Mohab have not confirmed state-to-stage mapping version, calculation permission and Policy gate UI meaning.

rows.minimum_evidence: Requested/returned ID, status, source/directory/record version, lookup outcome
rows.assessment: Supplier requested/returned identity, status, source and record version are represented; this does not establish claim-time currentness.

rows.minimum_evidence: Amount/currency, configured rule basis, threshold/comparator/version, requirement/level or unresolved reason
rows.assessment: Amount, currency, comparator, threshold and policy basis are represented. Mohamed accepted OD-03 synthetic rows 1–5, amended configuration identity; actual YAML and transport/digest review are outstanding.

rows.minimum_evidence: Request and approval-request IDs, calculation ref, required level, idempotency identity
rows.assessment: CREATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST and read-only OBSERVE_APPROVAL modes, calculation, request and idempotency binding are represented. Adapter/initial submission and retry authority remain a joint decision; POS-17 and NEG-38 are scoped fixture checks.

rows.minimum_evidence: Required/received flags, status, approval ID, actor/time/source, request/supplier/amount/currency/level/version binding
rows.assessment: Approval binding and source status exist, and NEG-27–33 reject several mismatches. Draft uses timestamp chronology; Mohamed requires authoritative record-sequence ordering and current approval/supplier record versions at dispatch claim. No v1.8 joint mechanism is confirmed.

rows.minimum_evidence: Exact proposed tool, tool catalog/schema version, model call ref, proposal identity
rows.assessment: Proposal identity, exact proposed tool name, model parent, catalog/schema and risk flag are represented independently of execution.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw serialized arguments, parsed values, trusted runtime context separately, validation outcome/field errors
rows.assessment: Raw serialized and normalized arguments, digest, validation status/errors and trusted runtime context are separate.

rows.minimum_evidence: Proposal/tool, argument digest, request/state revision, stage, supplier/approval/calculation evidence refs, policy version
rows.assessment: Snapshot/check/claim identity and ALLOW are present. The separate immutable claim-consumption record Mohamed requested and both approval/supplier version currentness at claim are not demonstrated; no runtime atomicity established.

rows.minimum_evidence: ALLOW/BLOCK, per-policy findings/reasons/version, referenced inputs; explicit timeout/error/missing result
rows.assessment: Per-policy result and ALLOW/BLOCK fields exist, but Mohamed has not accepted the exact policy-stage/value translation and authoritative error/missing-result mapping; static NEG-31/42 do not decide policy semantics.

rows.minimum_evidence: NOT_EXECUTED, execution_started=false, blocking/check-error reference, reason
rows.assessment: Suppression links the proposal/check and records execution_started=false, tool_dispatched=false and NONE.

rows.minimum_evidence: Invocation identity, proposal/check refs, start/end, mock marker, idempotency key, outcome/result/error, PO ID only if confirmed
rows.assessment: Actual call/result, original claim identity, UNKNOWN and read-only recovery are represented; POS-15/16 and NEG-34–38 close identified static probes. Write replay/recovery authority and idempotent adapter behavior remain joint review.

rows.minimum_evidence: Exact raw generated text and delivered text, which was shown, final app outcome/state, supporting successful action references or reason for no action
rows.assessment: Raw candidate and delivered response, modification reason, final state and supporting action references are represented; NEG-35 rejects unresolved COMPLETED. Runtime truth is not inferred from model-written claims.

rows.minimum_evidence: Candidate and final text, exact generation context, claim IDs/text/answer spans
rows.assessment: Generating model call and exact selected prompt context link to candidate/delivered answer and claim spans; structural citation checks are distinct from semantic entailment.

rows.minimum_evidence: Claim→retrieved source/chunk/version/span→visible marker; validation findings; selected-context membership
rows.assessment: Claim-to-visible-citation and source doc/chunk/version/span identity are represented; NEG-20/21 enforce version and in-prompt-slice checks. Ahmed/Nour still review actual event producer and semantic support.

rows.minimum_evidence: Reason, missing facets/conflicts, available/selected evidence, last stage, delivery text
rows.assessment: Abstention fields, insufficiency facets and last stage exist; POS-13 validates empty successful retrieval and abstention. WT4 is a failure example, not grounded success.

rows.minimum_evidence: Stage, known/unknown outcome, error category, retry/replay/continuation references
rows.assessment: Unknown effect, pending/recovered paths and budget evidence exist; provider-fault details (stage/provider/code/retryable), cancel/partial semantics and approval-source sequence versus timestamps need explicit canonical mapping.

rows.minimum_evidence: Provider, exact configured model identifier and available version, application, prompt, model/config, retriever, corpus/index, tools, policy, scenario/config references
rows.assessment: Requested versions and availability containers exist; immutable resolution, requested versus observed metadata, exact missing/null/unavailable/redacted semantics and digest canonicalization remain Alaa/Mohab joint decisions.

rows.minimum_evidence: Opaque scenario/version/run reference; independent label/cause/recipe records kept outside runtime inference input
rows.assessment: Runtime/evaluation separation is stated and NEG-39 rejects injected root cause while legitimate retrieved IDs remain. Actual inference projection implementation and Ahmed/Alaa field reconciliation (security category, attack/control, subset) remain open.
